content.title: Dow Jones Futures: Stock Market, Palantir Break Key Levels; Tesla Shareholders OK Elon Musk Pay
content.summary: Dow Jones futures: The stock market indexes and Palantir undercut key levels. Tesla shareholders voted in favor of the Elon Musk pay deal.

content.title: Take-Two (TTWO) Q2 Earnings: How Key Metrics Compare to Wall Street Estimates
content.summary: Although the revenue and EPS for Take-Two (TTWO) give a sense of how its business performed in the quarter ended September 2025, it might be worth considering how some key metrics compare with Wall Street estimates and the year-ago numbers.

content.title: ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Is Postponed Again — to November 2026
content.summary: Shares of Take-Two fell about 7% in extended trading after the delay was announced, overshadowing quarterly results that topped Wall Street estimates.  “It’s always painful when we move a date,” Chief Executive Officer Strauss Zelnick said on a call with investors.  The company told Bloomberg that the fired employees were leaking confidential information.

content.title: Take-Two Interactive (TTWO) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
content.summary: Take-Two (TTWO) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +60.44% and +12.93%, respectively, for the quarter ended September 2025. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

content.title: Take-Two Delays ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Again
content.summary: The delay of the next iteration of one of its most popular franchises pulled the videogame developer’s stock down in after-hours trading, despite an increased full-year financial view.

content.title: Take-Two falls in afterhours as further delay to GTA VI offsets guidance hike
content.summary: Investing.com--Take-Two raised its annual guidance Thursday, but reported mixed fiscal second-quarter results after posting a surprise loss and pushed back the release of the next edition of Grand Theft Auto to November next year.

content.title: Take-Two Earnings Slam Dunk Overshadowed By 'GTA 6' Delay
content.summary: Take-Two Interactive Software trounced estimates for its fiscal Q2 but announced a six-month delay for its “Grand Theft Auto 6” game.

content.title: Take-Two Stock Falls on Latest Grand Theft Auto Delay
content.summary: Take-Two announced that Grand Theft Auto VI would now be released in November 2026, six months later than expected.

content.title: Take-Two: Fiscal Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: The New York-based company said it had a loss of 73 cents per share. Earnings, adjusted for non-recurring costs and stock option expense, came to $1.46 per share. The results surpassed Wall Street expectations.
